title: Go Fast object one of four in line-abreast formation
summary: Merrick tells of Go Fast object one of four in line-abreast formation, about 2015 at off Jacksonville, Florida, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: this was one of four objects that were in a line of breast formation

I don't dispute that. What I dispute is the fact that this was a spherical object that had no flight control services or means propulsion traveling in in a in an intelligently controlled manner and and it was in formation. By the way, there was four.
tellings.difference: Adds that the object had no flight control surfaces or propulsion and moved under intelligent control, and rejects the parallax explanation.
tellings.link_reason: Both say the Go Fast object was one of four flying in formation, citing Ryan Graves.

as_told.title: Go Fast object was intelligently controlled and in a formation of four, not parallax
